name: Kyonyuu Onsen Kozukuri no Yu ~Yama no Naka no Hitou de Deatta no wa Bijin Oyako Deshita~
original_name: 巨乳温泉子作りの湯 ～山の中の秘湯で出会ったのは美人母娘でした～
source:
Company's bankruptcy, parting with a fiancée. In order to forget such a tough incident, I left for some secluded place away from home.

But, misfortune continues. After getting lost, I was stranded deep in a mountain, where there are no phone signals.

Everything goes wrong...

At the end of the despair, I finally lose consciousness.

And when I woke up, I was in a rural hot springs inn.

It is the glamorous and super beautiful landlady who saved me.

Together with a lovely and buxom daughter, two people manage the inn.

Both had voluptuous bodies and attractive sex appeal, and I was completely captivated.

I was at the bottom of my life. Is this paradise!?

In order to stay here, I offer a helping hand as thanks for the rescue.

If I'm lucky, even sexual relation... No, I have to reach a closer relationship first!

In a steaming hot springs inn, sultry days with beautiful busty mother and daughter begin!

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=891239]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
公司破产，与未婚妻分手。为了忘记这件事，我离开家去了一个僻静的地方。

但是，不幸仍在继续。迷路后，我被困在深山里，那里没有电话信号。

一切都不对劲…

绝望的最后，我终于失去了知觉。

当我醒来时，我已经在一家乡村温泉旅馆里了。

是那个光鲜亮丽、超级漂亮的房东太太救了我。

加上可爱丰满的女儿，两人经营着这家客栈。

两人都拥有丰满的身材和诱人的性感，我完全被迷住了。

我正处于人生的谷底。这里就是天堂吗！？

为了留在这里，我伸出援助之手，以感谢救援。

运气好的话，连性关系都可以……不，我得先达到更亲密的关系才行！

在热气腾腾的温泉旅馆里，与美乳母女的闷热日子开始了！
